title: Did Wildfires Spark the Invention of Pottery? - Nautilus
gist: A Geomorphology study by Amos Frumkin proposes the 'natural kiln hypothesis': Stone Age people in the Levant may have invented pottery by imitating clay hardened into ceramic by wildfires.

insights.claim: A study in Geomorphology proposes that Stone Age humans in the Levant got the idea of firing clay into ceramic by witnessing clay hardened by naturally occurring wildfires.
